LanguageData.SFRL_EnabledTip: Disabling this releases all inventory restrictions immediately. Manual settings and remembered hysteresis states are preserved.
LanguageData.SFRL_ControlSowingTip: Pause above the upper limit; resume below the lower limit. Manual Off and Smart Farming modes are preserved. High Density Hydroponics pauses strictly, even with a partially sown batch. Already growing crops continue growing.
LanguageData.SFRL_ControlHarvestTip: Uses the same per-crop thresholds and hysteresis state as sowing. Also blocks designated and already assigned harvest jobs inside growing zones and player growing facilities. Cutting commands and wild plants outside these areas are unaffected. Unharvested crops still age and can die. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.SFRL_Explanation: Read vanilla map stock counts every 600 ticks. Above upper: pause; below lower: resume; otherwise keep the previous state. New crops are ignored until configured.
LanguageData.SFRL_Compatibility: Smart Farming: {0} | High Density Hydroponics adapter: {1}
LanguageData.SFRL_NoProduct: No standard harvested product; not controlled.
LanguageData.SFRL_Uncounted: Product is not counted by vanilla; not controlled.
LanguageData.SFRL_IndependentRule: Each crop has its own limits and state, even when several crops produce the same item. Counts use item units, not stacks or nutrition. Threshold changes apply at the next 600-tick check.
LanguageData.SFRL_PausedBoth: {0}: sowing and harvesting paused by inventory limit.
